bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
current="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
test "$current" = "$(docker image inspect create-videobot:video-sale-1695-receipt-fixed --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 61
stage="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-video-link-stage.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$stage"' EXIT
docker cp "$cid:/opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs" "$stage/current.mjs"
test "$(git hash-object "$stage/current.mjs")" = "1d22b402359e330efa4eaa1dfc295896640ccff2" || exit 62
remote='repos/seigo-gace/create-videobot/contents/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs?ref=feat%2Fassistant-ai-and-sales-core'
test "$(gh api "$remote" --jq '.sha')" = "550f73a7947e628e0e707b2b9895816a658006b6" || exit 63
gh api "$remote" --jq '.content' | base64 -d > "$stage/paidListingPublisher.mjs"
test "$(git hash-object "$stage/paidListingPublisher.mjs")" = "550f73a7947e628e0e707b2b9895816a658006b6" || exit 64
chmod 644 "$stage/paidListingPublisher.mjs"
docker tag "$current" create-videobot:video-link-base-1695
printf 'FROM create-videobot:video-link-base-1695\nCOPY paidListingPublisher.mjs /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs\n' > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t create-videobot:video-sale-1695-preview-link "$stage" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node create-videobot:video-sale-1695-preview-link --input-type=module -e '
import {paidVideoPreviewLink} from "./src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs";
const r=paidVideoPreviewLink({chatId:-1002373696859,freeMessageId:4689,paidMessageId:4691});
if(r.reply_markup.inline_keyboard[0][0].url!=="https://t.me/c/2373696859/4691")process.exit(65);
' >/dev/null
echo NEW_PREVIEW_IMAGE_STAGED=PASS
echo COMPOSE_NETWORK_INTERNAL="$(docker network inspect deploy_default --format '{{.Internal}}')"
echo COMPOSE_NETWORK_DRIVER="$(docker network inspect deploy_default --format '{{.Driver}}')"
echo LIVE_POLL_UNCHANGED="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')"
